description:
Get a list of attack simulation campaigns for a tenant.

TIP: Lists attack simulation campaigns (phishing simulations). Each simulation has displayName, status, attackType (social, credential harvest, etc.), launchDateTime, completionDateTime, report with overview (resolvedTargetsCount, compromisedRate). Useful for tracking security awareness training effectiveness.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-attack-simulations
